finding.title: task-brief AWK parser never closes the last Task section on trailing non-Task headings (e.g. ## Self-Review, ## Execution Handoff) and toggles infence on nested backticks
finding.detail: In skills/subagent-driven-development/scripts/task-brief:30-36, intask is only updated when matching /^#+[ \t]+Task[ \t]+[0-9]+/. When extracting the final task of a plan written by skills/writing-plans/SKILL.md (which mandates trailing ## Self-Review and ## Execution Handoff sections), intask remains 1 and leaks every trailing section into the implementer subagent brief. In addition, /^```/ { infence = !infence } ignores fence length and ~~~ fences, so a 4-backtick outer fence containing a single 3-backtick block inverts infence for the rest of the plan.
finding.recommendation: Track the opening fence delimiter (3+ backticks or tildes) and task heading depth, and terminate intask when encountering any non-Task heading outside a fence with depth <= the current task heading depth.
